title: MOST — Quantifier & Reference

vocab.pt: A maior parte do meu dinheiro

expressions.example: For the most part, I enjoy my work — but it's stressful sometimes.
We only have one week in Paris — let's make the most of it!
I don't know for sure, but she's most likely going to accept the job.
The meeting will take an hour at most.

sentences: Most people believe that honesty is important.
I spend most of my time at work.
She chose the most expensive option.
He showed most of his work to the manager.
Most of my friends live in another city.
For the most part, I agree with your idea.
She most likely chose the best solution.
We make the most of every opportunity.

grammar.title: MOST — 3 Usos Essenciais
rules: Most + substantivo (geral, sem artigo): "Most people like music." → A maioria das pessoas
The most + adjetivo (superlativo): "The most important thing." → A coisa mais importante
Most of + the/my/his/... (referência específica): "Most of my money." → A maior parte do meu dinheiro
⚠️ Atenção: Most people (geral) vs. Most of the people (grupo específico)

rows: For the most part, I agree.

quiz.q: I spend ___ my time at work.

speak: I spend most of my time studying.
For the most part, I'm happy.
She most likely chose the best option.
Make the most of every day!
